settings.about: A collection of 20th-century banknotes found in museum archives and online. From the last notes of fallen empires to the first currencies of newly independent nations, each bill is a small record of its time: its art, politics and ambitions printed on paper. Browse the catalogue and see how a hundred years of history passed from hand to hand.

objectOntologyFields.label: Description
objectOntologyFields.value: Leather-bound album entitled 'Kwangtung Note Redemption July 1914' containing 30 stiff-board pages. There are 2 boards with hand-written explanation of the contents, followed by 1 blank board, 20 boards each with a banknote affixed and hand-written annotation, and 7 blank boards. The 20 notes all have individual records (CIB.EA.266.1 to CIB.EA.266.20).;
